title: SOS coordinate-range/all-or-none decode rules diverge in Rust and Python violating cross-impl vector parity
description: C sos_alert_from_cbor rejects out-of-range lat/lon + enforces pairing; rust/lichen-link/src/sos.rs:509-527 checks is_finite only accepting 91.0/-181.0 with independent lat/lon Options (:548-556); python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:508-540 same finiteness-only. Violates AGENTS.md identical-output mandate; committed negative vectors sos_lat_above_max/sos_lon_below_min would fail Rust/Python consumers once wired. Port exact C semantics (boundaries inclusive +-90/+-180, all-or-none MISSING_FIELD taxonomy aligned to error enums of each impl) + machine-drivable vectors.
close_reason: Ported C decoder semantics to both impls. Rust rust/lichen-link/src/sos.rs: coordinate_in_range inclusive lat [-90,90] lon [-180,180] with non-finite rejection -> SosCborError::InvalidValue; all-or-none lat/lon -> MissingField after required-fields check, before trailing-data (C precedence); preserved -0.0 and prior valid inputs. Python python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py CheckInResource: same contract mapped to existing BAD_REQUEST rejection class. Boundary matrix added on both: +/-90/+/-180 accepted incl pairs and -0.0 bit-preserved, one-ULP-beyond rejected (f64 bits+1), NaN/inf f32/f64 rejected via wire tokens plus f16 0xf9 tokens (NaN, +inf, -inf) and out-of-range f16 65504, in-range exact f16 values kept shortest-form, int coords valid, out-of-range ints rejected, lat-only/lon-only rejected, paired boundary values accepted. Gates green: cargo test -p lichen-link --all-features 152 lib tests ok incl sos_cbor_vectors driver now asserting 11 driven vectors; pytest test_vector_consumers_lci.py -k sos 34 passed 9 skipped; pytest tests/coap/test_sos_resource.py 107 passed; ruff check clean; cargo fmt/clippy -p lichen-link clean.
